Class SpringWebSocketConfig

java.lang.Object
com.owltask.infra.spring.websocket.SpringWebSocketConfig
@Configuration @DependsOn("owlTaskApplication") public class SpringWebSocketConfig extends Object
Single websocket endpoint carrying every OwlTask message type, mirroring ballworld.springConfig.websocket.SpringWebSocketConfig. Domain-agnostic - adding a new message type means registering one more processor on the shared MessageRouter, not touching this class.
